title: Efficacy of different oral H<sub>1</sub> antihistamine treatments on allergic rhinitis: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

answer.design_quote: The network meta-analysis was performed by using Stata 16.0, and the outcome measures of the analysis were symptom score reductions of patients.
answer.k_quote: 18 eligible randomized controlled studies, involving a total of 9419 participants, were included in this meta-analysis.
